Container.Name: IDrive
Container.Overview: Runs the official IDrive for Linux package with persistent state and read-only access to a Vaultwarden backup folder.
Container.Requires: Initial IDrive installation and account configuration are interactive. Open the container console and run install-idrive.

Config.Name: IDrive installation
Config.Description: Persistent IDrive program and state directory

Config.Name: Root configuration
Config.Description: Persistent root home for IDrive account state

Config.Name: Vaultwarden backups
Config.Description: Read-only source containing verified Vaultwarden archives
